reason: The price is nothing next to the hours I lose answering emails at night, but I've never heard of FLUGIA and 'AI co-workers' is what every startup promises this year. I'd probably poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying or plugging my CRM and mailbox into it this month.
objection: I've never heard of FLUGIA. Will the company still be around in two years, and what happens to my customer data and my automations if it isn't? I don't want to rebuild everything after it folds.
would_change_my_mind: If the free co-worker actually cleared my support inbox for two weeks without me fixing its answers, and a Belgian or Dutch business my size told me they've been running it for a year, I'd pay monthly.
